subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should autonomous unattended task looping become a core OpenClaw capability now, and if so should its permanent owner be a Gateway/session orchestration service rather than the TUI?
rationale: The feature aligns generally with better agent-harness capabilities, but it introduces a new command, flags, model tools, persistence model, subagent workflow, and safety policy; code review cannot choose those permanent product contracts.

options.title: Pause and redesign in Gateway
options.body: Sponsor the feature only after defining a Gateway-owned session contract that reuses goals/tasks, real usage accounting, SQLite state, and consistent surface behavior.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Implement the workflow as a plugin or skill using existing goal, task, subagent, and session APIs while core extension gaps are identified separately.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow experiment
options.body: Allow a clearly labeled TUI-only experiment with no shared command registration or global model tools, accepting that it is not yet the permanent architecture.

recommendation.title: Pause and redesign in Gateway
recommendation.body: Sponsor the feature only after defining a Gateway-owned session contract that reuses goals/tasks, real usage accounting, SQLite state, and consistent surface behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core product direction, session ownership, agent runtime, persistence, and multiple user surfaces.
